objectives.text: Find a way out of the cave you washed up in
Meet Lady Brisienna at _dirtypit_ in __dirtypit_, as her letter asks

outcomes.text: Lady Brisienna set you on Lysandus's trail: start with the royal families of Daggerfall, Wayrest and Sentinel.
Lady Brisienna waited in vain, and reported you to the Emperor as a traitor.
You never met the Emperor's agent in Daggerfall.

objectives.text: Find proof of what really became of Prince _brother_
Meet the stranger who wrote to you, at _agentplace_ in __agentplace_
Search ___ukcrypt_, the Underking's old crypt
Bring what you found to Prince Lhotun at Castle Sentinel

outcomes.text: Prince Lhotun has his brother's last words, and told you of Lysandus, Medora Direnni and her cursed tower.
You showed the certificate at court instead, and Sentinel called it blackmail.
You turned down Prince Lhotun's request.
Prince _brother_'s fate stayed buried.

objectives.text: Meet Prince Helseth at Castle Wayrest tomorrow for the letter
Deliver Prince Helseth's letter to Lord Castellian at _castfort_ in __castfort_
Bring Lord Castellian's reply back to Prince Helseth

outcomes.text: Lord Castellian's reply reached Prince Helseth unread; the Prince was pleased, and spoke of you to his mother.
Prince Helseth got his reply, but knew you had read it. He will not trust you again soon.
Princess Elysana's marriage made the letter needless, and Prince Helseth paid you 100 gold for your trouble.
Lord Castellian found his letter opened and set his guards on you.
You took Prince Helseth's letter to King Eadwyre, and the Prince's errand died there.
You turned down Prince Helseth's errand.
The letter was not delivered and answered in time.

objectives.text: Find the horn of the Great Unicorn in Shedungent, Nulfaga's castle in the Wrothgarian Mountains
Bring the horn to Medora in Direnni Tower

outcomes.text: Medora has the horn, and the Queen Dowager's curse on Direnni Tower is broken.
You turned Medora away.
The horn never reached Direnni Tower in time.

objectives.text: Deliver Princess Morgiah's letter to the _necs_ in Scourg Barrow, in the Dragontail Mountains
Bring the _necs_'s reply to Princess Morgiah within the month

outcomes.text: Princess Morgiah has the necromancers' answer, and told you Gortwog the Orc holds the Emperor's letter.
You turned down Princess Morgiah.
Princess Morgiah's letter went unanswered in time.

objectives.text: Find Nulfaga in her castle, Shedungent of Wrothgaria, and speak with her
Report Nulfaga's condition to Queen Aubk-i

outcomes.text: Queen Aubk-i knows Nulfaga still lives, mad as she is, and rewarded you for the news.
You declined to look in on Nulfaga.
Queen Aubk-i never learned how Nulfaga fares.

objectives.text: Bring Princess Elysana's robe to Lord Castellian at _casfort_ in ___casfort_
Return to Princess Elysana at Castle Wayrest

outcomes.text: Lord Castellian put on the robe and the daedra it summoned took him; Princess Elysana paid you well.
You found the daedric charm sewn into the robe and fought off what it called; Lord Castellian never wore it.
You declined Princess Elysana's errand.
The robe never reached Lord Castellian in time.

objectives.text: Put an end to the werewolf of Tristore Laboratory, in Betony
Find _barmaid_, named in the werewolf's diary, in ___barmaid_
Subdue the werewolf with the _relic_ instead of killing it
See _wereBrother_ safely to the witches who can tend him
Tell Cyndassa at Castle Daggerfall that the werewolf is dead

outcomes.text: The werewolf was Cyndassa's own brother. He is dead, and she told you what she knew of the Emperor's letter.
Cyndassa's brother lives on in the witches' care, and _barmaid_ told you what Cyndassa knew of the letter.
You turned down Cyndassa's bargain.
The werewolf of Tristore Laboratory still lives, and Cyndassa kept her secret.

objectives.text: Meet Lady Brisienna at _tavern_ in __tavern_
Find the Totem of Tiber Septim in the treasury of Castle Daggerfall
Escape Castle Daggerfall with the Totem
Choose who shall hold the Totem, and put it in their hands
Answer Nulfaga's summons at ___shedungent_

outcomes.text: Lady Brisienna holds the Totem for the Emperor, and gave you the Warlock's Ring.
Queen Akorithi holds the Totem for Sentinel, and paid you 100,000 gold for it.
Gortwog holds the Totem for the Orcs of Orsinium, and gave you Chrysamere.
The Underking's agent took the Totem for his master, and gave you the Necromancer's Amulet.
King Gothryd holds the Totem for Daggerfall, and paid you 10,000 gold for your change of heart.
The King of Worms holds the Totem, and promised you the adoration of the world.
You yielded the Totem to Daggerfall's knights, and King Gothryd holds it now.
King Eadwyre took the Totem for Wayrest, and set his battlemages on you rather than pay.
A year and a day passed, and the Totem left you for a worthier hand.
You refused Lady Brisienna, and the Totem was left to others.
The Totem never found its holder through you.

objectives.text: Call on Princess Elysana at Castle Wayrest, as her letter asks
Escort _foil_ to _contact_ at __contact_ in ___contact_

outcomes.text: _contact_ paid you off and fled. There was never any Totem in it. Princess Elysana had set you up.
You turned Princess Elysana down.
You never reached _contact_.

objectives.text: Meet the Underking's agent, _agentuk_, at _agentplace_ of __agentplace_ in Sentinel
Take back the Underking's _reward_ from Castle Llugwych in Ykalon
Bring the _reward_ to _agentuk_

outcomes.text: The Underking's agent lifted the curse on the _reward_, let you keep it, and revealed Lysandus's true tomb in Menevia.
You turned the Underking's agent away.
The _reward_ stayed with the Blades.

objectives.text: Answer Queen Barenziah's letter at Castle Wayrest
Find the lost chapter of Queen Barenziah's biography in the dungeons of Orsinium
Take the chapter back from the Necromancers in Scourg Barrow, in the Dragontail Mountains
Bring the chapter to Queen Barenziah at Castle Wayrest
Or bring the chapter to Gortwog in Orsinium, as he asked

outcomes.text: Queen Barenziah has her chapter, and warned you that Gortwog is after the Totem of Tiber Septim.
Gortwog has the chapter of Barenziah's book, and the Queen of Wayrest will not soon forgive you.
You turned down Queen Barenziah.
The lost chapter of Barenziah's biography was never recovered.

objectives.text: Ask for _dispatcher_ at _location_ in __location_, who can find the Emperor's messenger
Show Mynisera's signet ring to _messenger_ at _palace_ in __palace_
Bring _messenger_'s word, and the _jewelry_, back to Queen Mynisera

outcomes.text: Mynisera knows why the Emperor's letter went to Aubk-i: it was sent to the Queen of Daggerfall, and the crown had passed.
You turned down Queen Mynisera.
The Emperor's messenger came and went, and Mynisera learned nothing.

objectives.text: Answer Queen Aubk-i's letter at Castle Daggerfall
Find the parcel of papers Mynisera has been hiding at ___myndung_
Bring the letters to Queen Aubk-i

outcomes.text: Queen Aubk-i read Mynisera's burnt letters. They held a sad old secret, not the treachery she feared, and she thanked you with a gift.
You would not swear to Queen Aubk-i's secret.
Mynisera's letters stayed hidden at ___myndung_.

objectives.text: Bring down Lord Woodborne, Lysandus's murderer, by his death or his disgrace
Show Woodborne's diary to someone who will see him punished

outcomes.text: Lord Woodborne is dead by your hand, and Lysandus's ghost has its vengeance.
Wayrest's crown has Woodborne's diary; he will die a traitor, and Lysandus's ghost has its vengeance.
Woodborne's diary reached those who loved Lysandus, and things from beyond the grave carried Woodborne off.
You sold Woodborne's diary for gold; Lysandus's murderer went unpunished and his ghost still walks.
You showed Woodborne's diary to Daggerfall's crown, and Gothryd's guards turned on you.
Queen Akorithi called Woodborne's diary trash, and Lysandus's murderer went unpunished.
Lord Woodborne went unpunished.

objectives.text: Find the Mantella in the Mantellan Crux and touch it

outcomes.text: Numidium rose for the Totem in King Gothryd's hand, and Daggerfall's rule spread across the Bay.
Numidium rose for the Totem in the Emperor's hand, and the Iliac Bay came back under the Empire.
The King of Worms took Numidium's power for himself and passed beyond mortal reach.
Numidium rose for Gortwog's Totem, and Orsinium stood as a nation among nations.
Numidium rose for the Totem in Queen Akorithi's hand, and Sentinel's rule spread across the Bay.
The Underking reclaimed his heart, the Mantella, and passed at last into death.
Numidium rose for the Totem in King Eadwyre's hand, and Wayrest's rule spread across the Bay.
The Mantella was never touched.

objectives.text: Answer Queen Akorithi's summons at Castle Sentinel
Find the painting hidden in the dungeons of Castle Wayrest
Place the painting in Queen Akorithi's hands

outcomes.text: Queen Akorithi has the late King Lysandus's painting, and paid you as she promised.
You turned down Queen Akorithi.
The painting stayed hidden in Castle Wayrest.

objectives.text: Ask Gortwog in Orsinium where the Dust of Restful Death can be found
Take the Dust of Restful Death from ___crypt_ on the Isle of Balfiera
Bring the Dust to Medora in Direnni Tower

outcomes.text: Medora has the Dust of Restful Death. Gortwog's torn letter showed his orcs died trying to save Lysandus.
The Dust of Restful Death never reached Medora.

objectives.text: Find out who holds the Emperor's letter, then return to Queen Mynisera
Give Queen Mynisera's letter to Gortwog in the hall of Orsinium
Find the Emperor's letter somewhere in Orsinium
Bring the Emperor's letter to Queen Mynisera

outcomes.text: Queen Mynisera has the Emperor's letter at last: it warned that the Totem of Tiber Septim had been found.
You refused Queen Mynisera.
The Emperor's letter stayed in Orsinium.

objectives.text: Answer the King of Worms' summons at Scourg Barrow
Destroy the lich Prince Karolis in the depths of Castle Sentinel, with the _scarab_ in your pack
Bring the trapped soul to the King of Worms

outcomes.text: The King of Worms has Prince Karolis's soul, and told you the Underking is Zurin Arctus, Tiber Septim's betrayed Battlemage.
You refused the King of Worms.
Prince Karolis's soul was never brought to the King of Worms.

objectives.text: Return to Medora in Direnni Tower once the month has passed
Find King Lysandus's true tomb and sprinkle the Dust on his corpse

outcomes.text: The Dust calmed Lysandus's shade enough to speak, and he named the man who murdered him.
Lysandus's shade was never soothed.

objectives.text: Fight off the battlemages Queen Akorithi sends after the Totem

outcomes.text: The Totem is out of your hands, and the battlemages Queen Akorithi sends no longer hunt you.
The hunt for the Totem ended unresolved.

objectives.text: Fight off the assassins Wayrest sends after the Totem

outcomes.text: The Totem is out of your hands, and the assassins Wayrest sends no longer hunt you.
The hunt for the Totem ended unresolved.

objectives.text: Fight off the orcs Gortwog sends after the Totem

outcomes.text: The Totem is out of your hands, and the orcs Gortwog sends no longer hunt you.
The hunt for the Totem ended unresolved.

objectives.text: Fight off the vampires the King of Worms sends after the Totem

outcomes.text: The Totem is out of your hands, and the vampires the King of Worms sends no longer hunt you.
The hunt for the Totem ended unresolved.

objectives.text: Fight off the daedra the Underking sends after the Totem

outcomes.text: The Totem is out of your hands, and the daedra the Underking sends no longer hunt you.
The hunt for the Totem ended unresolved.

objectives.text: Take up the renown the King of Worms promised you

outcomes.text: The King of Worms kept his word: the guilds, temples and crowns of the Bay all hold you in high regard.

objectives.text: Win Queen Aubk-i's gratitude for your news of Nulfaga

outcomes.text: Queen Aubk-i thinks the better of you for looking in on Nulfaga.

objectives.text: Meet _contact1_ at _tavern_ in __tavern_, ____tavern_
Free _traitor_ from the dungeons of Castle Sentinel before his execution
Take _traitor_ to _contact2_ at _safehouse_ in __safehouse_, ____safehouse_

outcomes.text: _traitor_ is safe among his allies, and paid you what he could spare.
_traitor_ escaped Sentinel, but parted from you on the road before the safehouse, and you went unpaid.
_traitor_ was hanged in Sentinel before anyone could free him.
_traitor_'s rescue never came.

objectives.text: Answer _queen_'s letter at Castle Sentinel
Find _traitor_ in the dungeons of Castle Wayrest and bring him back to Sentinel
Return to _queen_ in Sentinel

outcomes.text: Sentinel's knights took _traitor_ off your hands before you reached the Queen, and the reward went with him.
You never answered _queen_'s letter, and she found other hands for the hunt.
_traitor_ came back to Sentinel in chains, and _queen_ had him executed.
_traitor_ died fighting in Castle Wayrest, and _queen_ was content the matter is closed.
_traitor_ is still at large.

objectives.text: Meet _rebel_'s messenger at _tavern_ in __tavern_ of ____tavern_
Meet _rebel_ inside Direnni Tower on the Isle of Balfiera
Find the _item_ _rebel_ wants, somewhere in Direnni Tower

outcomes.text: _rebel_ has his box from Direnni Tower, and gave you a piece of his own work for the help.
_rebel_'s jaunt to Direnni Tower came to nothing.

objectives.text: Meet _rebel_ at _tavern_ in __tavern_ in ____tavern_
Steal the map to ___itemdung_ from the Mages Guild of __magesguild_
Find the _key_ to ___itemdung_ in ___keydung_
Meet _rebel_ back at _tavern_ in __tavern_
Brave ___itemdung_ with _rebel_ and win its hoard

outcomes.text: You handed _rebel_ the _item_ and he vanished with a cheery farewell; the rest of the hoard is yours.
You kept the _item_ for yourself, and _rebel_ turned his magic on you for it.
You turned down _rebel_'s raid on the Mages Guild.
The hoard of ___itemdung_ was never won.

objectives.text: Keep off Daggerfall's streets at night until Lysandus's ghost is laid to rest

outcomes.text: The curse is lifted: Lysandus's dead no longer walk Daggerfall's streets at night.
The dead still walk Daggerfall's streets at night.

objectives.text: Read the letter your unknown friend sent about Numidium and the Totem

outcomes.text: A friend's letter told you of Numidium, and why every power on the Bay wants the Totem of Tiber Septim.
The friend's warning never reached you.

objectives.text: Lay the ghost of King Lysandus to rest
Find out what became of the Emperor's letter to the Queen of Daggerfall
Seek out the royal families of Daggerfall, Wayrest and Sentinel

outcomes.text: Lysandus's ghost is at rest, and the Emperor's letter is found.
The Emperor's mission in the Iliac Bay was left unfinished.
